::: {.callout-important}
The publicly available data used in the AV Resource Portal Data Dashboard limits the analysis and information presented due to the design of the data reports and redactions made by AV companies under confidential business information claims. Please see [Transparency](./transparency.html) for more information.
:::

::: {.column-body}
The first Autonomous Vehicle (AV) testing permits were issued by the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) in 2018 to companies testing without safety drivers.  The first driverless deployment permit was issued to Waymo in 2021.  Until this year (2026), a company operating under a deployment permit was not required to report any data to the DMV.  The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC), which regulates AV passenger services like Waymo and Zoox, began issuing AV pilot permits in XXXX and deployment permits in 2022.

The data used in the AV Resource Portal is from public versions of data released by the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC), and National Highway Transportation Safety Administration (NHTSA).
:::
